name: html-to-markdown-extension
description: Convert web articles, selections, or full pages into clean Markdown instantly.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:icons
scripts.zip: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json, _locales, icons, lib, src, package.json, README.md, LICENSE -DestinationPath html-to-markdown-extension.zip -Force"

author: Open Source Community
